令和8年第1回定例会の会議結果

name: こども家庭部を新設
summary: 現在の組織条例に、こども家庭部はありません。この議案で同部を新設し、子供や若者に関する施策、子育て支援、保育、青少年育成を所管事務に加えます。
changes: こども家庭部を新設する
子供施策と若者育成支援施策の企画・調整を所管する
児童育成、子育て支援、保育、青少年育成を所管する
why: こども家庭部を新設し、分掌事務を改めるためと、区長は説明しています。

en.name: Establishes a Children and Families Department
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Taito City Office Organization Ordinance
en.summary: The current organization ordinance does not include a Children and Families Department. This bill establishes the department and adds policies concerning children and young people, parenting support, childcare, and youth development to its areas of responsibility.
changes: Establishes a Children and Families Department
Makes the department responsible for planning and coordinating policies for children and support policies for young people
Makes the department responsible for child development, parenting support, childcare, and youth development
en.why: The mayor says this is to establish a Children and Families Department and revise its assigned duties.
